app.name: Ludiary
fatal.title: Ludiary could not start
fatal.masterKeyUnrecognized: Ludiary's stored keys use a format this version does not recognize, and they were left untouched. Update Ludiary to the latest version. Details are in the logs: {logs}
fatal.keyStore: Ludiary could not use the Windows Credential Manager, where it keeps its key. Try again and, if it keeps failing, check the logs: {logs}
fatal.database: Ludiary could not open its database. Check that there is free disk space and look at the logs: {logs}
fatal.databaseTooNew: This database was created by a newer version of Ludiary. Update Ludiary to open it; details are in the logs: {logs}
fatal.noPort: Ludiary could not find a free port on this computer for its local server. Check the logs: {logs}
fatal.timeout: The Ludiary server is taking too long to start. Wait a moment and open it again; if it keeps failing, check the logs: {logs}
fatal.unexpected: An unexpected error happened. You can attach the logs to an issue on GitHub: {logs}
web.open.title: Opening Ludiary
web.open.noscript: Ludiary needs JavaScript to open in this browser. Turn it on and open Ludiary again from its shortcut.
web.open.invalid.title: Invalid link
web.open.invalid.body: This link was already used or has expired. Open Ludiary again from its shortcut or from the tray icon.
web.missing.title: The interface files are missing
web.missing.body: Ludiary cannot find the files of its web interface. Reinstall Ludiary to repair it.

core.errors.launch.rejected: Ludiary rejected the launch request for safety and nothing was run.
core.errors.busy: Another operation is already running. Wait for it to finish.
